coleccionista.voz.bienvenida.no_sabes: I know you don't know who you are… or what you're doing here.
coleccionista.voz.bienvenida.piezas: Each of you is a piece. Unique. Fragile. Mine.
coleccionista.voz.bienvenida.una_sale: Tonight we will play several games… and only one piece will leave this place.
coleccionista.voz.bienvenida.listo: But tell me… are you ready to play a game?
coleccionista.voz.bienvenida.risa: Heh, heh, heh… Ha, ha, ha, ha!
coleccionista.voz.bienvenida.candado: Your cell has a lock. The code is closer than you think. Let the collection begin.
coleccionista.chat.candados: The locks work now. Find the three numbers… or stay here forever.
coleccionista.pista.nota1: The first number is %s. The other two are scratched on the walls.
coleccionista.diario.1: Day 3. I can't hear the piece next door anymore. Yesterday they screamed. Today there's only silence… and a new portrait in the hall.
coleccionista.diario.2: Don't trust your partner. I did. Now I'm writing this from… I don't know where.
coleccionista.diario.3: The Collector never lies. That's the worst part.
coleccionista.diario.4: If you find this: the numbers are always in the first thing you look at when you wake up.
coleccionista.diario.5: I counted the cells: twenty-four. I counted the beds: twenty-four. I counted the exits: one.
coleccionista.diario.6: His laugh gets stuck in your head. He laughs when someone fails.
coleccionista.diario.7: Don't sleep. When you sleep, he moves things around.
coleccionista.diario.8: The mask is cracked on one side. Up close, I'd swear something moves behind the crack.
coleccionista.candado.ayuda: Arrows or type the numbers · Enter
coleccionista.candado.muerto: The lock has no light… yet.
coleccionista.espera.nota: Don't disconnect: when everyone is ready, it will begin.

coleccionista.cmd.sala: Waiting room ready: everyone in their cell, in bed, in the dark.
coleccionista.cmd.solo_overworld: The map goes in the overworld.
coleccionista.panel.g_sala_ayuda: Everyone to their cell, in bed, in the dark, unable to touch anything.
coleccionista.panel.g_despertar_ayuda: Lights on and everyone wakes up with their cinematic (then 10 minutes to investigate).

coleccionista.panel.g_abrir_ayuda: Opens every door even without the code.
coleccionista.panel.g_disfraz_ayuda: Put on (or take off) the Collector's costume to appear in front of everyone.

coleccionista.enc.chat.tiempo: Time's up. The gate closes… and the gas waits for no one.
coleccionista.enc.chat.fin: The trial is over. %s pairs were saved. The rest… are mine now.

coleccionista.enc.hud.tu_llave: Your key is in Piece %s's barrel: ask for it.
coleccionista.enc.hud.su_llave: Their key is in your barrel: take it out and throw it with Q.
coleccionista.voz.encadenados.hola: Good morning, pieces. Did you sleep well?
coleccionista.voz.encadenados.cadena: Each of you is bound to someone. You didn't choose them… I did.
coleccionista.voz.encadenados.llaves: Your keys aren't with you. They're in your partner's barrel.
coleccionista.voz.encadenados.gas: When the gate opens, gas will start filling the sewers. Don't breathe it for long.
coleccionista.voz.encadenados.cupo: At the end of the tunnel there's a shelter. There isn't room for everyone.
coleccionista.voz.encadenados.suerte: What binds you… also saves you. Let the game begin.

coleccionista.panel.pruebas_proximas: All 7 trials are here. Suggested order: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 and the final.
coleccionista.panel.enc_estado.lista: Ready: everyone chained, waiting for your signal
coleccionista.panel.enc_estado.cierre: The gate closed: eliminating those outside…

coleccionista.com.chat.hablen: You have %s seconds to talk with your partner. Then each of you will choose in secret.
coleccionista.com.chat.perdon: Stealing to the very end? How greedy… I won't run out of pieces today.
coleccionista.com.chat.fin: Every table has been revealed. %s pieces stayed in my collection.

coleccionista.voz.compartir.mesa: In front of you is your partner for tonight.

coleccionista.voz.compartir.elijan: Then each of you will choose in secret: share… or steal.

coleccionista.voz.compartir.confianza: Trust is beautiful. It also comes at a price.

coleccionista.com.elegiste_robar: You chose STEAL. Nobody else knows… yet.
coleccionista.com.elegiste_compartir: You chose SHARE. Nobody else knows… yet.
coleccionista.com.hud.perdonado: You don't play this time: the Collector spared you
coleccionista.com.hud.hablen: Talk with %s: then you'll choose in secret
coleccionista.com.res.roban: Both stole: both stay in the collection.

coleccionista.voz.sacrificio.valiente: Who will be the brave one?

coleccionista.voz.ciegas.ultimo: The last team out loses its guide. For guiding badly.
coleccionista.panel.cie_preparar_ayuda: Fade to black and random teams (of 3, or /evento ciegas tamano N): the guide above on the glass; the rest inside.
coleccionista.panel.cie_empezar_ayuda: The Collector explains and it starts (those inside blindfolded).
coleccionista.panel.cie_cortar_ayuda: It ends: the slowest team loses its guide.
coleccionista.panel.cie_terminar_ayuda: Ends the trial without eliminating anyone else.
coleccionista.panel.cie_estado.lista: Ready: each team in its maze, waiting for your signal
coleccionista.panel.cie_nota: Each team in its maze. The guide walks above on the glass and sees everything (traps in red); the rest walk blindfolded and only hear their voice. Stepping on a trap sends you back to the start. The slowest team (or those that don't finish) loses its guide.
coleccionista.pue.cmd.discurso: The Collector explains The Doors; round one starts when he's done.
coleccionista.panel.pue_discurso_ayuda: The Collector explains the trial on the screens and then round 1 starts (or use Next round to skip it).
coleccionista.voz.puertas.hola: Welcome to the Hall of Doors.
coleccionista.voz.puertas.tres: Three doors. Behind each one, a booth.
coleccionista.voz.puertas.piso: In one of them the floor opens… and the water below is very, very deep.
coleccionista.voz.puertas.pista: Before each round I'll give you a hint. I almost always tell the truth.
coleccionista.voz.puertas.tiempo: Choose quickly: whoever isn't inside before the bars close… lets me choose.
coleccionista.fantasma.voz: Your voice now goes to the ghost channel: only other ghosts hear you. You can still hear the living nearby.
coleccionista.voz.estado: Voice chat: %s · living: %s · ghosts: %s · on loudspeaker: %s · groups for the living: %s
coleccionista.voz.no_instalado: Simple Voice Chat isn't installed on the server: no voice.
coleccionista.voz.solo_jugador: Only a player can use this.
coleccionista.voz.altavoz_si: Loudspeaker on: everyone hears you wherever they are (press again to turn it off).
coleccionista.voz.altavoz_no: Loudspeaker off: your voice is proximity again.
coleccionista.voz.grupos_si: The living can now use voice groups.
coleccionista.voz.grupos_no: The living can't use voice groups: proximity only.
coleccionista.voz.org_no: Organizers no longer hear the ghost channel.
coleccionista.panel.g_altavoz_ayuda: Your voice reaches everyone wherever they are (like the complex's speakers). Press again to go back to proximity voice.
coleccionista.chat.salvado_final: %s is spared… for now. I need pieces for my final.
coleccionista.voz.salas_si: In Blind, The Traitor and The Sacrifice each team will only hear its own.
coleccionista.voz.salas_no: Voice is no longer split by rooms: everyone by proximity.
coleccionista.enc.regla.1: You're chained to the wall and to your partner.
coleccionista.enc.regla.2: Your key is in your partner's barrel: ask for it. Keys are thrown with Q.
coleccionista.enc.regla.3: Cross the sewers together before the gas reaches you.
coleccionista.enc.regla.4: There's no room for everyone in the Shelter: whoever stays outside falls.
coleccionista.tra.regla.1: Each of you has a note with part of the vault code.
coleccionista.tra.regla.2: One of you is the traitor: their numbers are fake.
coleccionista.tra.regla.3: You have 3 tries on the keypad to open the vault.
coleccionista.tra.regla.4: If you open it, the traitor falls. If not, the traitor chooses who I take.
coleccionista.com.regla.1: You get a partner, face to face. First you talk.
coleccionista.com.regla.2: Then each of you chooses in secret: SHARE or STEAL.
coleccionista.com.regla.3: If both share, both go on. If one steals, the one who shared falls.
coleccionista.com.regla.4: If both steal, both fall. If you don't choose, you share.
coleccionista.cie.regla.1: One of your team is the guide: they walk above and see the whole maze.
coleccionista.cie.regla.2: The rest walk blindfolded: they only have the guide's voice.
coleccionista.cie.regla.3: Stepping on a trap sends you back to the start.
coleccionista.cie.regla.4: The last team out loses its guide.
coleccionista.sac.regla.1: Your team is locked in: the gate only opens if someone stays.
coleccionista.sac.regla.2: To offer yourself, stand on the altar for 5 seconds.
coleccionista.sac.regla.3: If nobody offers, you vote in secret. The most voted stays.
coleccionista.sac.regla.4: Whoever stays falls. The rest walk free.
coleccionista.pue.regla.1: Each round, choose one of the three doors and enter its booth.
coleccionista.pue.regla.2: Behind one of them, the floor opens.
coleccionista.pue.regla.3: Before each round I give you a hint. I almost always tell the truth.
coleccionista.pue.regla.4: If you don't get in on time, I choose for you.
coleccionista.cop.regla.1: One of the cups on the table is poisoned.
coleccionista.cop.regla.2: Taking turns, each one drinks a cup (right click).
coleccionista.cop.regla.3: If nobody falls, the cups are poured again.
coleccionista.tres.sin_mapa: The Post Gallery isn't built yet: use /evento construir.
coleccionista.tres.ya_empezo: Chained in Threes is already running: end it before preparing it again.
coleccionista.tres.pocos: At least 3 living pieces are needed.
coleccionista.tres.fundido: Cold hands lead you by the arm to another room…
coleccionista.tres.lema: Three of you make one whole
coleccionista.tres.chat.elegir: On the table there's a blindfold, a tape and handcuffs. Decide who wears what: you have %s seconds.
coleccionista.tres.chat.listos: Very good… you've chosen. Put them on.
coleccionista.tres.chat.empieza: The gates open. You have %s minutes. The last trio out… stays with me.
coleccionista.tres.chat.pierde: Trio %s was late… and stays in my collection.
coleccionista.tres.no_hablar: Your mouth is taped: you can't type.
coleccionista.tres.no_tocar: Your hands are cuffed: you can't touch anything.
coleccionista.tres.ya_tienes: You already chose. Leave something for the others.
coleccionista.tres.tomo.venda: put on the BLINDFOLD (won't see a thing).
coleccionista.tres.tomo.cinta: put on the TAPE (won't be able to talk).
coleccionista.tres.tomo.esposas: put on the CUFFS (won't be able to touch anything).
coleccionista.tres.hud.elige: Choose at the table: right-click the blindfold, the tape or the cuffs
coleccionista.tres.hud.elegiste: You put on: %s · wait for your trio
coleccionista.tres.hud.rol.venda: BLINDFOLD: you barely see. Listen to your trio
coleccionista.tres.hud.rol.cinta: TAPE: you can't talk. Use signs
coleccionista.tres.hud.rol.esposas: CUFFS: you can't touch anything. Guide with your voice
coleccionista.tres.cmd.preparada: Chained in Threes ready: each trio in its table room.
coleccionista.tres.cmd.empieza: Chained in Threes: time to choose.
coleccionista.tres.cmd.no_toca: That can't be done right now in Chained in Threes.
coleccionista.tres.cmd.pierde_uno: One random member of the trio loses.
coleccionista.tres.cmd.ajustes: Choose: %s s · course: %s s · chain: %s blocks.
coleccionista.tres.regla.1: Your trio chooses at the table: one wears the blindfold, one the tape and one the cuffs.
coleccionista.tres.regla.2: Blindfold: you barely see. Tape: you can't talk or type. Cuffs: you can't touch anything.
coleccionista.tres.regla.3: You go chained in a line: the chain snags on the posts if you pass on different sides.
coleccionista.voz.tres.objetos: On your table there are three gifts: a blindfold, a tape and handcuffs.
coleccionista.voz.tres.venda: Whoever wears the blindfold won't see a thing.
coleccionista.voz.tres.cinta: Whoever wears the tape won't be able to say a word.
coleccionista.voz.tres.esposas: And whoever wears the handcuffs… won't be able to touch anything.
coleccionista.voz.tres.decidan: Decide among yourselves who wears what. If you don't, I will.
coleccionista.voz.tres.cadena: Then you'll cross my gallery chained together. Mind the posts: chains get tangled.
coleccionista.voz.tres.suerte: The last trio out stays with me.
coleccionista.panel.tres_preparar_ayuda: Fade to black and random trios, each to its table room (leftovers make trios of four).
coleccionista.panel.tres_empezar_ayuda: The Collector explains, then they choose blindfold, tape or cuffs.
coleccionista.panel.tres_arrancar_ayuda: While choosing: leftovers are handed out and the gates open. On the course: time's up.
coleccionista.panel.tres_terminar_ayuda: Ends the trial without eliminating anyone else.
coleccionista.panel.tres_estado.lista: Ready: each trio in its room, waiting for your signal
coleccionista.panel.tres_nota: Extra trial (wildcard). Random trios in the Post Gallery. At the table they choose: blindfold (barely sees), tape (can't talk or type) and cuffs (can't touch anything). Then they cross chained in a line; the chain snags on posts. The last trio loses (/evento tres pierde trio|uno). Needs Simple Voice Chat for the tape.
